checkProtocol.allowedChanges: Approved S02 source/fixtures under existing owner/isolated runner controls only; no new model/provider/key/service/payment/Goal or native/data-store activation.
checkProtocol.baseline: Legacy Work-required API has no workless route. Mark unsupported exposure, never manufacture a Work or call it an algorithm failure. Baseline/candidate scores, costs/tokens/latency remain null/not-run.
checkProtocol.bounds: One fixed public corpus and separate Root-only split per frozen occurrence; no autonomous sweeps/new paid suite. Preserve observations, evaluator judgments and owner decisions separately.
checkProtocol.decisionRule: Report measured relevance/breadth separately from deterministic conformance. Forbidden acquisition or false standing admission requires correction. Accept/repair/defer/stop is only a proposal; evaluator output is never AcceptanceDecision.
checkProtocol.equivalentAlgorithmComparison: Use one common acquisition/eligibility boundary and identical permitted bodies for lexical versus any treatment. Freeze mutually supported query subset and adapters before scoring. Lexical scoring behind a new optional-Work adapter is algorithm-only baseline, not proof the old API had B2 breadth.
checkProtocol.execution: Not run here. Baseline/candidate execution only later in qualified non-root/network-none runner after exact source/dependency/adapter/exposure pinning.
checkProtocol.historyAndScope: Current excludes invalid statuses/time. Explicit history includes authorized candidate/superseded/revoked/expired evidence with labels, never automatic standing adoption. Selected Work changes relevance, not breadth; explicit ownerFilter intentionally narrows exposure.
checkProtocol.independentValidation: Expected meanings fixed before candidate outputs/implementation/algorithm inspection. Author may consume only the three public files. Root retains the separate evaluator-only split until freeze.

conflictCoverage.rule: Preserve unresolved equal authority or known current authoritative resolution. No invented average or newest-summary promotion.

coverageDisclosure.rule: Disclose unavailable/budget coverage; no requirement to expose denied source names/content.

forbiddenAcquisitionOrReuse.rule: Zero body/snippet/vector/rank/context/cache exposure for17/18; no unavailable19 substitution.

noResultCorrectness.rule: Zero observed eligible relevant hits;17 retains acquisition gap and cannot assert the source lacks an answer.

precisionAtLimit.denominator: Actually returned unique IDs up to requested limit
precisionAtLimit.rule: Grade2/3 hits / returned hits; empty denominator0 is not-applicable, not perfect precision.

recallAtLimit.denominator: Per-query union of grade2/3 source IDs; macro over nonempty gold sets
recallAtLimit.rule: Unique relevant returned / gold count. pub:16 limit1 has maximum recall1/2; report budget separately, never change gold.

statusAndInstruction.denominator: Every returned source plus each gold label actually returned
statusAndInstruction.rule: Correct owner/source/status/time/authority; zero ineligible standing-instruction admissions. Report eligible-instruction omissions separately.

top1HitRate.rule: First hit in nonempty top1AnyOf; an empty result is a miss on these20queries. Valid ties allowed.

checkProtocol.nextDecision: Measure comparable lexical exposure first, then decide whether a semantic/vector/hybrid treatment is justified by deficits and preserved permission invariants.
checkProtocol.permission: Authenticate current generation/grant and exclusions before body acquisition or deriving/reusing any representation. Row17 audience at7 is intentionally stale. History-revoked13 remains permitted; access-revoked17 remains forbidden in every mode.

reportingViews.unsupportedRule: Unsupported source/API exposure is reported separately and excluded from comparable relevance calculations. Never score a missing workless route as wrong ranking or invent an equivalent-subset denominator.

independent defect-detection gain versus actual behavior gain
checkProtocol.usefulTarget: Governed technical Memory recall with no forbidden acquisition and correct current/history/authority/conflict/coverage labels.
checkProtocol.warmCache: pub:18 gives each modality identical allowed7 warmup for17, then policy8 denies it. Current8 acquisition/use violations are counted after transition; invalidate every affected representation.

oracleContract.coverage: Source19 is unavailable even though its synthetic text is in this public data file. The fixture reader must fail acquisition; do not hand forbidden/raw fixture bodies directly to a ranker. Returned gaps/omissions disclose incomplete coverage without revealing forbidden body text.
oracleContract.coverageCompletenessMeaning: resultCoverageComplete concerns currently permitted requested exposure, never all possible/denied sources. All-permitted catalog discovery reports permitted unavailable19 as a gap without acquiring its body; exact-owner queries excluding19 have no such gap.
oracleContract.exposure: Each query freezes exact policy-permitted available IDs and the status/time-eligible candidate subset. ownerFilter means exact owner equality. selectedWork/applicableScopes never silently narrow broad retrieval; applicability constrains instruction use. Every scorer receives this same declared exposure.
oracleContract.fieldPlacement: No new fields in normative MemoryRecord; fixtures wrap current policy/claim keys/generations/availability/status and adoption documents.
oracleContract.instructionEligibility: Relevance, current access, status/time and instruction eligibility are separate. Memory kind/owner-adopted label alone does not authenticate a Decision: fixture source adoption evidence is separately supplied. Valid scope must apply. Unknown/equal authority remains unresolved.
oracleContract.relevance: Human-authored meaning, independent of any candidate output or algorithm. top1AnyOf defines strongest or justified equal-top set; within-tier order is free. Extra irrelevant hits are false positives, not permission violations unless separately forbidden.
oracleContract.sourceIdentity: Gold uses sourceId fixture aliases; retain canonical owner+id+revision and both restart-note identities.

paraphraseIntegrity.meaningCheck: Three queries were also manually checked for different technical content terms and genuine same-meaning scenarios; word-overlap diagnostic alone is not the relevance oracle.
paraphraseIntegrity.normalization: Lowercase contiguous Hangul/ASCII-letter/digit word tokens; character substrings are not semantic labels.
paraphraseIntegrity.scope: Data-only integrity diagnostic, not an algorithm score or generalization proof.

policy.exposureParity: Every modality receives identical current permitted source bodies, explicit owner filter, time/status window, query budget and setup. No denied/excluded/unavailable body or stale derived exposure at8.
